# Reporting Cadence

*Last updated: March 2026*

---

## Overview

All reporting at ASLF Formulas is **fully automated**. AI agents compile and deliver reports on a defined schedule. The owner receives structured digests without manual data entry or spreadsheet work.

---

## Daily Report (AI-Generated)

**Delivery:** Every morning by 8:00 AM (owner's local time)
**Delivery method:** Email and/or dashboard notification
**Generated by:** Shopify + Klaviyo + ad platform APIs, compiled by automation (e.g., Make.com, Triple Whale)

**Contents:**
- Revenue (yesterday vs. same day last week)
- Orders placed and fulfilled
- Ad spend and ROAS (yesterday)
- Top-selling product(s)
- Any KPI alerts triggered in the past 24 hours

---

## Weekly Report (AI-Generated)

**Delivery:** Every Monday by 9:00 AM
**Generated by:** AI agent compiling 7-day data

**Contents:**
- Weekly revenue summary and trend
- Marketing performance (by channel)
- Email performance (open rate, CTR, revenue from email)
- Customer acquisition metrics (CAC, new customers)
- Support ticket summary (volume, resolution time, themes)
- Inventory status
- OKR progress snapshot

---

## Monthly Report (AI-Generated)

**Delivery:** 2nd of each month
**Generated by:** AI agent compiling prior month data

**Contents:**
- P&L summary (revenue, COGS, gross margin, ad spend, net)
- Full KPI scorecard vs. targets
- Best/worst performing products
- Customer cohort analysis (new vs. returning)
- Email list growth
- Inventory reorder summary
- Key wins and issues from the month

---

## Quarterly OKR Review (Owner-Led)

**When:** First week of each new quarter
**Format:** Owner reviews AI-generated quarterly report and sets new OKRs

**Quarterly report includes:**
- OKR results (achieved / missed / in progress)
- Year-to-date financials
- Customer growth trends
- Strategic recommendations from AI analysis

---

## Tools Used for Reporting

| Report | Source Data | Compilation Tool |
|---|---|---|
| Daily digest | Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta/Google Ads | Triple Whale / Make.com |
| Weekly summary | All platforms | Make.com / custom AI agent |
| Monthly P&L | Shopify, accounting tool | Accounting tool + AI agent |
| Quarterly OKR review | All platforms | Owner-reviewed AI report |
